name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix
description: Single-shot Fortinet Mantis bug → fix → MR pipeline. Input is just bug_id + project + base_branch + three editable prompts (focus / MR body / Teams message). Fetches summary/description/reporter/assignee/etc from Mantis at run time, has Claude propose a minimal fix, opens a GitLab MR via glab, notifies assignee + reporter on Teams. v0.7.22 — also tags the MR with forge:keyword::automation-test when the bug's Keywords field contains 'QA Automation Test'.
author: forge
